BiblicalUsage: It is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, what He did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon, and in Vaheb in Suphah. The book itself is lost to us, and Vaheb is known only from this one quotation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Vaheb matters because it is quoted, not described: the book of the wars of the Lord names a place we know nothing else about, and the Bible is honest that some of God's victories are recorded elsewhere and lost to us.
